summary: HUTCHMED filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing that the US FDA granted Orphan Drug Designation to sovleplenib for autoimmune hemolytic anemia, its second such designation after primary ITP in October 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation is involved; the designation confers seven years of US market exclusivity plus tax credits, PDUFA fee waivers, and regulatory guidance if approved. Chinese NDAs in primary ITP and warm AIHA remain under NMPA review. This is an ordinary product-regulatory disclosure, not a special situation; watch ESLIM-01/02 data and approval timing.
